piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Humour, idioms and cultural references
texto: Contextual reading of a literary criticism article on the evolution of proverbs and satirical humour in contemporary Thai society: read how modern writers reinterpret traditional sayings to comment on urban realities. Analyse the warning that losing the historical context makes the deeper sense of metaphors incomprehensible.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การทำความเข้าใจบริบททางประวัติศาสตร์ช่วยให้ตีความความหมายของสำนวนโบราณได้ถูกต้อง» express?

opciones.texto: Knowing the history of the homeland illuminates the true sense of old proverbs.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การทำความเข้าใจบริบททางประวัติศาสตร์ช่วยให้ตีความความหมายของสำนวนโบราณได้ถูกต้อง» from the text.

opciones.texto: A sense of humour eases tension and builds closeness between speakers.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Using idioms appropriately to the situation reflects refined linguistic skill.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
